scope.independence: Author implementation and verification only. No independent review claim for these three owned sources.

contract.v1: Original five-field implicit-v1 binding and schema-1 exact thirteen-field record remain accepted. Its input-artifact same-subject-spec constraint is unchanged; get_observation_contract remains version-1-only.
contract.v2_binding: Original five fields plus exact integer version=2 and input_artifact_bindings.
contract.v2_record: Original thirteen fields with exact integer schema=2 plus input_artifact_bindings; no version field in a record.
contract.provenance: Exact input ID keyset maps to {producer: complete AttemptRef, spec_fingerprint, content_sha256}. Each current artifact metadata entry must match its compact reference and common scope. Inputs may have different original specs from each other and from the observation subject.
contract.result_authority: Every nonempty observation requires result_artifact_ids from the exact current RUNNING evaluator AttemptRef and same scope, independently of the subject spec.
contract.bounds: Explicit list/tuple factory inputs, claims and result IDs; at most 32 each. Store continues to accept an exact list batch, at most 32. None never becomes an empty observation batch. Existing 32768-byte per-record, finite JSON, depth 16 and 8192-node limits unchanged.
contract.atomicity: Store requires caller-owned transaction and current RUNNING full Ref; whole batch names/IDs, metadata dependencies and readbacks verified. Failures require full caller rollback. No SQL schema changes.
factories: cpu_observation_binding(*, adapter_id, protocol_fingerprint, spec_fingerprint, scope, input_artifacts) -> dict
